q1_issues.issue: "the stations of the Middle Row" is encoded as (LocatedIn sk_mr_stations_1 middle_row), asserting a spatial containment the text never states; a genitive of-phrase routes through Possessive / genitive NP (PartOf or Possession), which is exactly what the parallel "Northcove stations" correctly got.

"recorded the redistribution in the Watch ledgers" takes the event's spatial Location, but a document/medium in-phrase is the preposition-named oblique In (the instruction set's "in a statement" case), so this asserts the recording happened at a place that is the ledgers.

notes: Across and Possession are used exactly as the open-class oblique and proper-noun-premodifier rules license, and the central_pool fusion with its positional-modifier genus follows the east_wing pattern. (Recipient sk_contribute_1 sk_pool_1) for an inanimate container is defensible under "goal of a transfer" but sits close to the Goal boundary.
